summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting progress on its €1.0 billion share buyback programme announced on 30 April 2026. During the week of 1–5 June 2026, ING repurchased 1,450,000 shares at an average price of €26.39, totaling €38.3 million. Cumulatively, 8,950,000 shares have been repurchased at an average price of €25.71, representing 23.01% of the programme's maximum value. The buyback aims to reduce share capital, with no board recommendation or advisors named. The programme is open-market and ongoing; watch for weekly updates and completion timelines.
